sources.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
sources.note: Capability/routing evidence; no hard residual beyond mature routing, specialization, or experience-selection explanations.

sources.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
sources.note: Later failures becoming visible after earliest-failure repair are reachability/right-censoring unless a same-later-state residual survives; large endpoint jumps after bottleneck repair are not a new mechanism. Similar-task transfer is capability evidence without a matched applicability boundary.

sources.title: Towards Risk-free AI Agent Deployment
sources.note: Survey/deployment perspective, not a first-party experiment. Citation-led numeric failure-diagnosis examples are secondary literature. This source exposed the typed-v2 ownership bug fixed by typed-v3.

sources.title: BaT: Towards Self-Evolving Medical Research Agent with Stage Rubrics
sources.note: Repeated fixed diagnostic evaluation is used to select curriculum/checkpoints, so it is not untouched final evidence. Model-size-dependent transfer sign alone does not establish an agent-specific mechanism.

sources.title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory
sources.note: Too little pruning accumulates low-utility entries; aggressive pruning removes useful skills. Memory below No Memory is covered by compatibility/revalidation unless a residual survives.

sources.title: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness
sources.note: No first-party irreducible failure or boundary with enough released evidence was identified in this pass.

sources.title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
sources.note: Related-work links are not treated as an author release; no hard first-party residual was identified.

sources.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
sources.note: Fixing historical failures can introduce new errors; this is the mature overgeneralization/negative-transfer mode absent a residual after applicability conditioning.

sources.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a $15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
sources.note: Strong harness-scaling capability evidence; no hard irreducible anomaly was isolated.

sources.title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
sources.note: One arXiv HTML-v1 typed-extraction fetch returned 404; identity and author-declared code provenance were independently verified. Fetch failure is not a scientific negative.
